current.text: Portland's backcourt is crowded. Lillard, Morant, Holiday and Avdija share the on-ball work, and Henderson is listed off the bench.
He is expected to be a bench player at about 20 minutes, with few chances to play more. Minutes and usage across Portland's rotation are expected to swing from game to game.
Portland was rumored to be in a trade for Jaylen Brown, and that deal would likely send out Henderson or another guard.
The newer Blazers preview doubts that Portland makes a consolidation trade.
Only 47.3% of his potential assists turn into assists.
His low assist conversion is likely tied to poor finishing by teammates such as Clingan and Camara.
Portland has three back-to-backs in the fantasy playoff weeks.
He returns from a season with many missed games.
